scope: The six-storey 1934 Main Block of Tung Wah Hospital, also known as the Li Shiu Chung Memorial Building, in May 2025. Its two exterior entrance porches, assembly-hall entrance and associated facade are in scope. The neighboring hospital towers are recorded for context.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The hospital operator gives the assembly hall address as the ground floor of Li Shiu Chung Memorial Building.
The government appraisal identifies a six-storey building plus mezzanine, two Classical entrance porches, scored render, rectangular small-pane windows, storey bands and a parapet cornice.
